project.name: Auth Service
project.description: Owns the internal authentication service and its versioned HTTP APIs.

issues.summary: Remove Auth API v1 on October 1
issues.content:
Issue: AUTH-900
Summary: Remove Auth API v1 on October 1
Type: Change
Status: Approved
Assignee: Asha Rao
Reporter: Neel Shah
Labels: breaking-change, api, deprecation

Description:
On 2026-10-01 Auth Service will remove Auth API v1 and the POST /v1/auth endpoint. Auth API v2 at POST /v2/auth replaces v1. Every consumer must migrate before the removal date. Known consumers are MCP Gateway and Argo Orchestrator.
